chains.title: GATA2 alt-binding enhancer activation

links.claim: GATA2 binds the alt A allele more strongly than ref C; no QBiC-SELEX data are supplied in this prompt, so this is based on GATA motif logic and GATA2 neuroblastoma enhancer biology.
The alt A allele creates or strengthens a functional GATA2-responsive element in the LMO1 regulatory region.
Increased GATA2 occupancy at this element increases LMO1 expression.
This occurs in SK-N-SH-like sympathetic neuroblastoma cells, where LMO1 is expressed and GATA2 is relevant.
Higher LMO1 expression increases neuroblastoma risk or aggressiveness.

predictions: Allele-specific GATA2 ChIP-qPCR shows more GATA2 on alt A than ref C at rs2168101.
LMO1 enhancer reporter is more active with alt A than ref C in SK-N-SH.
GATA2 knockdown reduces LMO1 expression in cells carrying alt A.
falsified_if: Alt A does not increase GATA2 occupancy at rs2168101 in SK-N-SH or other sympathetic neuroblastoma cells.
The rs2168101 alt allele does not increase LMO1 enhancer reporter activity or endogenous LMO1 expression.
Conditioning on a linked variant abolishes the rs2168101 association.

chains.title: No TF-mediated allelic effect
predictions: No allele-specific TF occupancy at rs2168101.
No allele-specific LMO1 enhancer reporter difference.
The association is explained by a linked causal variant, a passenger event at a mutational hotspot, or no allelic effect.
falsified_if: Allele-specific GATA2 or GATA3 occupancy and allele-specific LMO1 enhancer activity are reproducibly detected.
Conditioning on a linked variant does not explain the association.
Perturbing GATA2 or GATA3 changes LMO1 expression in an rs2168101 allele-dependent manner.

chains.title: GATA3 alt-binding enhancer activation

links.claim: GATA3, a related GATA-family TF, binds the alt A allele more strongly than ref C; no QBiC-SELEX data are supplied in this prompt, so this is motif-based and GATA3 is included because related TFs share specificity.
The alt A allele creates or strengthens a functional GATA3-responsive element in the LMO1 regulatory region.
Increased GATA3 occupancy at this element increases LMO1 expression.
This occurs in SK-N-SH-like sympathetic neuroblastoma cells.
Higher LMO1 expression increases neuroblastoma risk or aggressiveness.

predictions: Allele-specific GATA3 ChIP-qPCR shows more GATA3 on alt A than ref C at rs2168101.
GATA3 knockdown reduces LMO1 expression in cells carrying alt A more than GATA2 knockdown.
GATA3 supershift, not GATA2 supershift, changes the allele-specific EMSA band.
falsified_if: GATA3 does not occupy rs2168101 in SK-N-SH or other neuroblastoma cells.
GATA3 knockdown, but not GATA2 knockdown, changes LMO1 expression from the alt allele.
GATA2, not GATA3, is the predominant factor at this element.

chains.title: GATA2 alt-binding repressive/context-dependent effect
chains.element: LMO1 regulatory element, context-dependent repressive or competitive effect

links.claim: GATA2 binds the alt A allele more strongly than ref C; no QBiC-SELEX data are supplied in this prompt. GATA2 is considered because the allele is predicted to alter a GATA motif.
The alt A allele creates a GATA2-bound element that is repressive or competes with an activating element in this context.
Increased GATA2 occupancy at this element decreases LMO1 expression.
This repressive effect occurs in SK-N-SH-like sympathetic neuroblastoma cells.
Lower LMO1 expression would be protective or alter neuroblastoma differentiation, depending on context.

predictions: Allele-specific GATA2 ChIP-qPCR shows more GATA2 on alt A.
LMO1 enhancer reporter is less active with alt A than ref C in SK-N-SH.
GATA2 knockdown increases LMO1 expression in cells carrying alt A.
falsified_if: Alt A increases rather than decreases LMO1 expression in allele-matched reporter and endogenous-expression assays.
GATA2 occupancy is absent or not allele-specific at rs2168101.
The variant has no effect on LMO1 expression after GATA2 perturbation.

matrix.test: Allele-specific ChIP-qPCR for GATA2 and GATA3 at rs2168101 in SK-N-SH or another heterozygous sympathetic neuroblastoma line, with genotype-matched input.

outcomes.outcome: GATA2 ChIP-qPCR signal enriched on alt A
GATA3 ChIP-qPCR signal enriched on alt A
GATA2 ChIP-qPCR signal enriched on alt A, but reporter activity lower for alt A
No allele-specific GATA2 or GATA3 occupancy

next_experiment: Cheapest single experiment separating the top two chains: allele-specific ChIP-qPCR for GATA2 versus GATA3 at rs2168101 in SK-N-SH or another heterozygous neuroblastoma cell line. C1 predicts GATA2 enrichment on alt A; C2 predicts GATA3 enrichment on alt A; C4 predicts no allele-specific enrichment.
